Boxing stance

Stance: Orthodox places your left side forward. Southpaw places your right side forward and adjusts lead and rear instructions.

Lead and rear movements are adjusted to match your stance.

Display

Main page layout: Standard keeps the open workout view. Compact places the timer and workout information in a shorter wide card for small screens.Clock size: Makes the main countdown smaller or larger without changing its timing.Callout size: Adjusts the combo text independently from the clock.Compact round labels: Uses abbreviated one-line focus names inside the round pips. When off, full labels can use two lines.Show workout time left: Shows or hides the smaller total-workout countdown below the main timer.Show secondary format: Displays punch names below numbers, or numbers below punch names.Show keyboard shortcuts: Shows or hides the assigned keys inside the workout control buttons.Show full-screen button: Shows the full-screen control in the desktop header. It stays hidden on mobile.

Audio

Voice callouts: Turns spoken coach instructions on or off.Number speed: Changes how quickly punch numbers are spoken.Word speed: Changes how quickly separate actions such as slip, pivot, and kick are spoken. It does not affect round announcements.Body-target gap: Adds a small natural breath inside targeted punches such as 3 body without separating them into two commands.Word-move gap: Controls the breathing room between genuinely separate instructions such as slip outside and pivot. Multi-word moves stay together.Test combo: Speaks targeted punches followed by several word-based moves using the readout settings.Final-seconds warning: Enables or disables the warning and hides its controls when off.Warning timing: Sounds with 10, 15, or 20 seconds remaining.Round-start sound: Plays after the spoken round announcement, before the timer and first combo begin.Fine tune: Each gear reveals strike count, spacing, pitch, and ring-length controls.Reset sound: Restores only that sound to the Cornerwork default.Test sound: Plays the sound immediately using every current adjustment.

Keyboard shortcuts

Changing keys: Select a field and press the key you want. If it is already assigned, the two shortcuts switch places.Start or pause: Starts the workout or pauses the current countdown.Next phase: Moves forward one phase at a time, including warmup, rounds, and rests.Previous phase: Moves backward one phase at a time, including rests and warmup.Mute voice: Quickly turns spoken callouts on or off.
